metadata.title: Soul Revival Live Album Aesthetic
useCases: Retro soul and funk event posters

retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy 1960s soul aesthetic featuring motion-blurred live performance photography paired with bold, multi-colored serif display type.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic composition where a warm-toned, motion-blurred photograph of a performer is anchored by heavy, vibrant, multi-colored display typography at the top, creating a sense of rhythmic energy and live atmosphere.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant multi-colored text against a dark, high-contrast background
Motion-blurred subject providing a sense of kinetic energy
Top-heavy typographic hierarchy balanced by a central warm-toned figure
Warm stage lighting (oranges/reds) contrasting with cool-toned text accents
coreInvariants: Intentional motion blur in the photographic subject
High-contrast black background in the upper third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A central figure in the lower two-thirds, scaled to fill the width with blurred secondary figures in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, multi-colored display text at the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright yellow text, moves down through the green and red title, and follows the diagonal motion of the blurred performer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black space at the top provides a canvas for the primary typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm oranges, ambers, and reds from stage lighting.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant primary yellow, green, and cyan used for typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the text and light highlights against a low-value, dark background.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to primary and secondary process colors for text

characterSpecificRedesigns: Tightly curled tails on lowercase 'y' and 'g'
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold, playful rounded serifs for the main title paired with functional, condensed sans-serifs for technical metadata.
graphicDevices: Rectangular call-out box with rounded corners
Horizontal rule lines for technical headers

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the iconic rounded, heavy-weight serif look of the era.
Provides the necessary weight and high-contrast serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photograph of a soul singer performing live under warm amber stage lights. Use a slow shutter speed effect to create significant motion blur, especially in the hands and background musicians. The top third of the frame should be mostly dark/black negative space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, heavy rounded serif text in the top left. Color each word differently using a palette of bright yellow, lime green, sky blue, and coral red. Add a small condensed sans-serif metadata line in the top right in yellow.

verificationChecks: Is the main title text multi-colored?
Does the photography feature visible motion blur?
Is the typography a heavy, rounded serif style?
Is the background dark enough to make the colors pop?

adjustableVariables: Specific color sequence of the title words
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible against the blurred background
Check that the motion blur feels intentional and rhythmic
Verify the multi-color palette feels cohesive and retro
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Motion Blurred Live Performance Photo] + [Top-Aligned Multi-Colored Cooper Black Typography] + [High Contrast Warm/Dark Lighting]
